1.title: Judge Who Struck Down Trump’s Compensation Fund Asks: Will Trump Just Pay Allies Another Way?
1.summary: The question was raised at a court hearing by a federal judge who has already barred the fund from moving forward.

2.title: Trump Courts North Korea’s Leader, but Might Need China to Reignite the Flame
2.summary: President Trump has gotten no love back yet from Kim Jong-un. He could turn to Xi Jinping, China’s leader, to help set up a summit when Mr. Xi visits Washington next week.

3.title: Trump Calls A.I. Fears a Hoax. Inside the White House, the Debate Is More Complex.
3.summary: The president seems driven chiefly by the sense that A.I. is the way to economic growth, and nothing can be allowed to stand in its way.

4.title: Protests Erupt in Nigeria After Police Pack 66 Miners Into One Cell
4.summary: Thirty-seven people died in the authorities’ custody, officials said. Two survivors said the cell had barely any ventilation, food, or water. People began “collapsing and dying,” one said.

5.title: St. Pierre and Miquelon, France, In the Spotlight as Macron and Carney Visit
5.summary: St. Pierre and Miquelon, the French territory off the coast of Canada’s Newfoundland, is experiencing a surge in visitors after three unrelated events raised its profile.

6.title: A Central African Hotel Has Become a Nightmare Prison for U.S. Deportations
6.summary: Witnesses say men were hooded and beaten in Equatorial Guinea. The autocratic government there is a partner in President Trump’s deportation program.
